caption: Table 47-2. Stages of periodontal disease.*
rows:
Clinically normal
No gingival inflammation or periodontitis clinically evident.

Gingivitis only
No attachment loss. Height and architecture of the alveolar margin are normal.

Early periodontitis
Less than 25% attachment loss or Stage 1 furcation involvement in multirooted teeth.

Moderate periodontitis
25 to 50% attachment loss or Stage 2 furcation involvement in multirooted teeth.

Advanced periodontitis
Greater than 50% attachment loss or Stage 3 furcation involvement in multirooted teeth.
